The width profile goes from a 1px tip at rows 3-5 to a broad 30-32px base at rows 23-28, so the silhouette is pointed rather than elliptical. Column x=16 shows facet bands (a highlight at row 9, then lighter and darker steps), and these are vertical facets, not horizontal tops. The only candidate top is the dark mauve strip at rows 25-26 on the base, which is a 1-2 row rim. Below it, rows 27-30 are a dark front face that narrows from 30px to 22px. No crystal has a top plane with a front-edge line or eave shadow, so the object reads as a front elevation.
